mintAuthority.headline: Collateral managers and a USDG PSM mint eUSD, while a three-of-five Safe can upgrade every minter proxy or grant MINTER_ROLE with no timelock.
mintAuthority.summary: EUSD (0x8b84d644) is a non-proxy ERC-20 token whose MINTER_ROLE is currently held by eight UUPS-upgradeable contracts: four EUSDManager risk groups (A through D), two EUSDLiquidityManager contracts (USDG and low-vol), EUSDPsm, and the mint-paused legacy eSPY manager. The 3-of-5 Governance Safe (0x470f35a7, SafeL2 1.4.1, zero guard, zero modules) holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE directly on EUSD with zero timelock, allowing it to grant MINTER_ROLE to arbitrary addresses, enable ERC-7802 bridges, or immediately upgrade all minter proxies and FablesAdapter vault beacons via ProtocolRegistry ADMIN_ROLE (only registry DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE transfer carries a 10,800-second delay).

controls.label: Own Governance Safe (EUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and UUPS upgrade authority)
controls.capDescription: Holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE directly on EUSD with zero timelock (can grant MINTER_ROLE to arbitrary addresses and raise ERC-7802 bridge caps) and ADMIN_ROLE on ProtocolRegistry (can raise manager and PSM debt ceilings and execute immediate UUPS upgrades on all eight minter proxies and vault beacons). ProtocolRegistry.defaultAdminDelay() applies a 10,800-second (3-hour) delay only to transferring registry DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

controls.evidence: At Robinhood Chain blocks 124271952 and 124274762, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x470f35a7e5d4cd490d74799ac01e7beea7f478e2) returned true on EUSD (0x8b84d644...) and ProtocolRegistry.defaultAdmin() returned the same Safe with defaultAdminDelay() = 10,800s. Safe reads confirmed SafeL2 1.4.1 singleton 0x29fcb43b46531bca003ddc8fcb67ffe91900c762, threshold 3 over 5 owners, empty getModulesPaginated(0x1, 10), zero guard slot, and CompatibilityFallbackHandler 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99. The separate Treasury Safe (0x8f974d82...) shares the identical 5 signers and 3-of-5 threshold. Signer independence and legal key custody are not publicly established.

controls.label: Own EUSDManagers A through D and Low-Vol LiquidityManager (collateral CDP minters)
controls.capDescription: Five active UUPS minter proxies with MINTER_ROLE: EUSDManager A (0xf9c9a09e, 2,000,000 cap, 0 debt), EUSDManager B (0xbd0a8dea, WETH, 2,000,000 cap, 149.62 eUSD debt), EUSDManager C (0x6d491928, 2,000,000 cap, 0 debt), EUSDManager D (0x948df8d2, 1,000,000 cap, 0 debt), and EUSDLiquidityManager Low Vol (0x62f48245, 0 debt), plus mint-paused legacy eSPY EUSDManager (0x9748964d, 383.60 eUSD debt). All proxies remain UUPS-upgradeable without delay by the Governance Safe.

review.evidence: Pinned Robinhood Chain reads at blocks 124271952, 124274762, and 124275851 (2026-11-27) confirmed EUSD (0x8b84d644cecaee6d21373f37e1ba00f85ed7cdb7) is a non-proxy ERC-20 token (EIP-1967 slot zero) matching own-protocol/own-v2 EUSD.sol, with maxNetBridgedIn() = 0 and totalSupply() = 141,513.73 eUSD reconciling exactly to totalDebt() across EUSDPsm (65,879.28), EUSDLiquidityManager USDG (75,101.23), legacy eSPY manager (383.60, mint paused), and EUSDManager B (149.62). All eight MINTER_ROLE holders are UUPS proxies controlled through ProtocolRegistry (0x348c4267...) by the 3-of-5 Governance Safe (0x470f35a7e5d4cd490d74799ac01e7beea7f478e2, SafeL2 1.4.1, zero guard, zero modules), which also holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE directly on EUSD with zero timelock. Because the Governance Safe can immediately grant MINTER_ROLE, raise caps, or upgrade any minter proxy without delay, economicCapSemantics is unbounded and authorityPosture is unbounded-adverse. Security reports published in own-protocol/own-v2/audits (September 9, November 1, and November 14, 2026) document multi-agent adversarial security reviews rather than audits by a named independent human security firm.
